issues: 上一镜尾巴是灰骨架占位 dashboard，收黑与 LOGO 段是大面积纯 #000，像黑屏而不是片尾卡
LOGO 是白方块套黑方块 + Helvetica 粗体 ACME，像占位图标，入场 opacity+scale 同帧到位没有跟随
彩蛋是灰骨架界面的放大局部，读不出是什么按钮，和 LOGO 段色调几乎一样，「眨眼」不明显
彩蛋前后画面完全一样，彩蛋和收尾之间没有任何因果
changes: look 改 custom「noir」：暖色相近黑舞台 + 奶白字 + 唯一强调色绯红，全段 2.39:1 电影遮幅——片子「在影院里结束」
上一镜尾巴重做成产品收尾画面：150px 大标题「Every frame, graded.」+ 一帧前后对比的调色画面，遮幅从画外合拢、ease-in 压暗入黑
LOGO 重做为新月 + 晚星图形标（虚构品牌 Vesper）+ 128px 宽字距字标：图形标对焦入场 12f，字标逐字以中心为原点字距收拢晚 3f，绯红短线 + 日期行最后落座
彩蛋 12f 硬切到无遮幅的整屏绯红：巨型白色胶囊按钮「Get early access」（104px）、失焦次按钮与光斑做浅景深，f3 光标按下 → f5 翻黑「You're on the list」+ 勾弹出，前推 4%
切回后 LOGO 像素一致，唯一变化是晚星被点亮成绯红——给彩蛋一个因果；时长 142→150f，尾段定格 64f 有极缓推镜与光的呼吸
issuesEn: The previous-shot tail was a grey skeleton dashboard, and the black and logo sections were flat pure #000, reading as a dead screen rather than an end card
The logo was a white square in a black square with a bold Helvetica ACME, like a placeholder; opacity and scale landed on the same frame with no follow-through
The egg was a magnified crop of the grey skeleton UI, unreadable as a button and almost the same tone as the logo card, so the blink barely registered
Frames before and after the egg were identical; nothing connected the egg to the ending
changesEn: Custom noir look: warm near-black stage, cream type and one crimson accent, with 2.39:1 letterbox bars throughout so the film ends in the cinema
The tail is now a real closing product shot: a 150px headline 'Every frame, graded.' beside a before/after graded film still; the bars close in from off-frame and it fades to black with ease-in

New logo: a crescent + evening-star mark (fictional Vesper) and a 128px wide-tracked wordmark; the mark focus-pulls in over 12f, letters track in from the centre 3f later, then the crimson rules and date line settle

The 12f egg hard-cuts to a full-bleed crimson frame with no letterbox: a giant cream pill 'Get early access' (104px), a defocused secondary pill and bokeh for shallow depth; the cursor presses at f3 and at f5 it flips to black 'You're on the list' with a springy tick, pushing in 4%
Back on the logo, pixels match except the evening star is now lit crimson, giving the egg a consequence; duration 142→150f with a 64f end hold that keeps a very slow push and breathing light
